caption: The drawing depicts a single piece of outerwear and a matching bonnet displayed against a plain, light background. The outerwear is a long, hooded cloak that is predominantly blue on the outer side, with a visible quilted lining in a deep pink color. The cloak features detailed trim work along the hems, front opening, and the edges of the wide, layered sleeves, all in a coordinating blue and pink pattern. The front of the cloak is fastened with a series of decorative buttons and loops. The matching bonnet, shown above the cloak, is also blue on the outside with the same quilted pink fabric on the inside, and it is tied at the neck with a pink ribbon. Both garments are rendered in a realistic style, with careful attention to shading and texture to indicate the materials and structure.
title: Child's Coat & Bonnet
